data.name: Blythe
data.gender_notes: Blythe is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English word ‘blith’ meaning cheerful, bright, or happy. The name Blythe was often given to girls born into happy or prosperous families. The name Blythe carries the meaning “Happy, cheerful, bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Blythe usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, cheerful, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope and joy in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Blythe belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Happy, cheerful, bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Blythe total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בלית הוא שמה של נערה נוצרייה שמשמעותו שמחה ועליזות, הוא נגזר מהמילה האנגלית העתיקה 'blithe' שפירושה שמחה ועליזות, והוא משויך לנערות נוצריות שגדלות באנגליה ובארצות הברית, ומשמעותו הרוחנית היא שמחה ועליזות בלב

in_greek.name: Μπλάιθ
in_greek.meaning: Χαρά και ευθυμία για το κορίτσι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μπλάιθ είναι ένα θηλυκό όνομα που προέρχεται από την αγγλική λέξη 'blithe' που σημαίνει χαρά και ευθυμία, και είναι δημοφιλές στις χριστιανικές κοινότητες της Αγγλίας και των ΗΠΑ, και συμβολίζει τη χαρά και την ευθυμία που έρχεται από τον Θεό

in_latin.name: Blythe
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Blythe est femininum nomen christianum quod significat gaudium et hilaritas, et derivatur ex anglica vetere voce 'blithe' quae eadem significatione habet, et est in usu communiter in ecclesiis christianis Angliae et Americae Septentrionalis, et denotat gaudium et hilaritatem quae ex Deo procedit
